data.name: Guide.Welcome.Intro
data.value: MasterEvent is an assistant for Game Masters and players alike. It lets you manage your RP events directly in-game: field markers, dice rolls, initiative, character sheets, weather and more, all synchronized in real time.

data.name: Guide.Welcome.Feature.Templates.Desc
data.value: Define the rules for your events (HP, EP, dice, stats, counters).

data.name: Guide.Welcome.Feature.Sheets.Desc
data.value: Create and manage profiles for each participant.

data.name: Guide.Welcome.Feature.Weather.Desc
data.value: Control the weather and Eorzean time for all players.

data.name: Guide.Welcome.Feature.Sync.Desc
data.value: Everything is automatically shared between the GM and players.

data.name: Guide.Welcome.Outro
data.value: This assistant will guide you through creating your first template and character sheet.

data.name: Guide.Rgpd.Data1
data.value: Character name (shared with other party members)

data.name: Guide.Rgpd.Data3

data.value: Character sheets, dice rolls and event templates

data.value: Anonymized identifier (hash) used in server logs

data.name: Guide.Template.Intro
data.value: A template defines the rules for your event: health points, ether, dice, stats and counters. All players joining your session will use this template.

data.name: Guide.Template.Field.Hp.Desc
data.value: Percentage or points mode. Set the default maximum for players and creatures.

data.name: Guide.Template.Field.Mp.Desc
data.value: Optional. Can be hidden if your event doesn't use ether.

data.name: Guide.Template.Field.Stats.Desc
data.value: Assign stat points to your characters (Strength, Dexterity...).

data.name: Guide.Template.Field.Counters.Desc
data.value: Additional status bars beyond HP and EP (stamina, dark mana...).

data.name: Guide.Template.Import.Desc
data.value: Your Game Master gave you a share code? Enter it here to import their template.

data.name: Guide.Sheet.Intro
data.value: A character sheet is a player's profile, based on a template. It contains their HP, EP, stats and custom counters.

data.name: Guide.Sheet.Step1
data.value: Go to the Sheets tab (scroll icon).

data.name: Guide.Sheet.Step4
data.value: Adjust values (max HP, stats, counters) then save.

data.name: Guide.Sheet.Tips
data.value: You can set a default sheet (star) so it loads automatically. Use the load button to apply a sheet in session.

data.name: Guide.Sheet.SetupIntro
data.value: Create a sheet for your character. It will be linked to the chosen template and contain your HP, EP, stats and counters.

data.value: Save and link to my character

data.value: Now, test your setup! Click a button to roll a die.

data.name: General.ShowTacticalOverlay.Tooltip
data.value: Shows an initiative band at the top of the screen and HP bars above participants during combat. Per-player local setting.

data.name: General.TacticalCamera.Tooltip
data.value: Tilts the camera into a pulled-back top-down view, BG3-style, only during turn-based combat. Local setting, independent from the overlay. Your pre-combat framing is restored at the end.

data.name: Chat.TacticalCameraOn
data.value: Tactical camera enabled: it will apply during turn-based combat.

data.name: General.TacticalCameraAutoCombat.Tooltip
data.value: Automatically enables the tactical camera during a turn-based encounter, then restores it when the encounter ends. Local setting.

data.name: General.HideNameplatesInCombat.Tooltip
data.value: Hides the native FFXIV names and health bars during a turn-based encounter, keeping only the tactical overlay bars. Restored when it ends. Local setting.

data.name: General.PlayDeadAtZeroHp.Tooltip
data.value: Automatically plays the /playdead emote when your HP reaches 0. Purely cosmetic (RP). Does nothing if you haven't unlocked the emote. Local setting.
